title: One Model, Two Roles: Emergent Specialization in a Shared Recurrent Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2605.17811v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can a shared-weight recurrent Transformer---one that repeatedly applies the same Transformer to update evolving latent states---develop distinct internal roles without being partitioned into separate modules? We study this in Asymmetric Input Recurrence (AIR), a minimal two-state reasoning architecture in which the same Transformer model is reused for both updates (per literature, L and H) and the only built-in difference in the update rule is that the encoded input is injected during L-updates but not H-updates. Across Sudoku-Extreme and Maze, decoded rollouts reveal a consistent split: $z_H$ behaves like a fully committed proposal state, whereas $z_L$ retains local uncertainty and shifting intermediate structure. Freeze interventions provide evidence of dynamical dependence between the two states, with responses that vary across tasks, intervention directions, and seeds. translated_title: 一个模型，两种角色：共享权重复现式Transformer中的涌现式角色分化
translated_abstract: 一个共享权重的循环Transformer——即反复应用同一个Transformer来更新不断演化的潜在状态——能否在不被划分为独立模块的情况下发展出截然不同的内部角色？我们在非对称输入循环（Asymmetric Input Recurrence, AIR）架构中研究了这一问题。这是一个极简的两状态推理架构，其中同一个Transformer模型被同时复用于两种更新（按文献记为L和H），更新规则中唯一的内置差异是：编码后的输入在L更新期间被注入，而在H更新期间不被注入。在Sudoku-Extreme和Maze任务上的实验中，解码出的推理过程揭示出一种一致的分工：$z_H$ 表现得像一个完全确定、已提交的提议状态，而 $z_L$ 则保留局部不确定性并呈现不断变化的中间结构。冻结干预实验为两个状态之间存在动力学依赖关系提供了证据，其响应随任务、干预方向和随机种子的不同而变化。消融实验表明，要诱导出这种角色分化，共享……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现共享权重的循环Transformer在无需模块划分的情况下能自发涌现出两种截然不同的内部角色——作为完全确定提议状态的$z_H$与保留局部不确定性的$z_L$，而输入注入的非对称性是驱动这种专业化的关键机制。
en_tdlr: A single shared-weight recurrent Transformer can spontaneously develop two distinct internal roles—a fully committed proposal state and an uncertainty-retaining exploratory state—emerging without explicit modular partitioning, driven solely by asymmetric input injection.
